guard/31293.htm.text: Guard Gunter: Halt! Who goes there? Oh, are you an adventurer? What are you doing here? Are you lost? Obviously, this village has an upper level and a lower level . It's unlike any of the other villages of Aden kingdom! Strangers tend to get lost here.

links.text: "Tell me more about the upper and lower levels."
"Who is the lord of the manor and what is the tax rate?"

guard/31293-1.htm.text: Guard Gunter: The village is divided into two levels. The lower level consists of residential housing, stores and various race guilds.
